correctness.rationale: The domain is exactly the \(2^{24}\) labelled binary assignments on the McGee LCF graph. The C++17 program enumerates all successors and traverses the finite functional digraph without sampling; it rejects cycles longer than two and counts each basin and first-periodic-entry class. A separate NumPy/NetworkX implementation checks \(F^{13}=F^{11}\) at all 16,777,216 inputs and exhibits x=152253 with \(F^{12}(x)\ne F^{10}(x)\). It agrees on 550 fixed points, 63,715 primitive two-cycles, all 12 entry rows and each 1,033,256-state unanimous basin. A complete graph automorphism enumeration of size 32 and canonicalization of both two-cycle phases yield 39 fixed-state and 2,415 two-cycle spatial classes. The two programs were replayed from the packaged paths and their saved output files were compared.

originality.rationale: The classical general period-two theorem proves only eventual period at most two. Exact tree classifications, random graph results and prior named-graph majority results have distinct hypotheses and do not imply the sharp McGee 11-step bound or its full labelled and symmetry-resolved counts. Queries of public mathematical publications and indexed findings with the McGee/7-cage/LCF aliases found no exact or stronger McGee result. The priority judgment is bounded by accessible material; an inaccessible early full text and unindexed sources remain acknowledged risks.
residual_risks: The complete 1980 Goles–Olivos article could not be directly inspected; only its abstract and later full-text citations were read.
Indexed abstracts for some related named-graph dynamics were not expanded to full text; their graph inputs differ, and the same-object search remains bounded.
Unindexed or inaccessible older exact McGee computations may exist, so the novelty assessment does not certify worldwide priority.

value.rationale: This is the complete dynamical classification for the canonical unique cubic girth-seven cage, not a random unmotivated finite slice. Exact first-entry and basin data clarify relaxation and consensus selection, and the sharp eleven-update delay is supported by only 320 extremal configurations, all entering two-cycles. Full spatial class counts distinguish geometry from labelled-state multiplicity; these precise properties are not supplied by the classical period-two theorem and form natural comparators for majority dynamics on cubic cages. A finite self-contained invariant can be valuable without a new universal theorem.
